direction: Inside the kitchen by candle and firelight. Flagstones, an oak dresser with plates, and a low peat-and-coal fire in the inglenook. A box bed stands by the hearth, where a dying person would most likely be brought for warmth. Amy lies propped on pillows. On the dresser, beside the candlestick, a folded farm schedule and an account book hint at the fields she has known. Slow lateral drift past the dresser toward the bed. Ambience only: fire, wind at the window, a clock ticking.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 still, interior of a Welsh farmhouse kitchen in 1864 at night, stone flagstone floor, large inglenook fireplace with a low glowing fire and an iron kettle on a chain, oak dresser with blue-and-white plates, tallow candles, a wooden box bed beside the hearth with an elderly woman lying propped on white pillows under a wool blanket, folded old paper documents and a worn ledger on the dresser, warm amber light against deep shadow, painterly naturalism, no readable text, no heraldry
